tasks.title: 301-redirect all 54 dead URLs
tasks.detail: Use apps/customer/src/lib/redirects.json. Cover http, https, www and non-www. Then click "Validate fix" in Search Console > Page indexing > Not found (404).
acceptance: Every 'from' path in apps/customer/src/lib/redirects.json returns a single 301 to its 'to' path on https://mrssamuel.com
No redirect chains or loops
Unknown URLs still return a real 404 status
tasks.note: Server-side 301s (apps/customer/src/lib/redirects.ts) + http->https. Owner: confirm the 'owner: confirm' rows in apps/customer/src/lib/redirects.json, then Search Console > Not found (404) > Validate fix after deploy.

tasks.title: Clean up www and duplicate URLs
tasks.detail: Every internal link, social bio, QR code and WhatsApp catalogue link points to https://mrssamuel.com. Self-referencing canonical on every page.
acceptance: grep finds no 'www.mrssamuel.com' or 'http://' self-links in src/ or public/
Every prerendered page has exactly one <link rel=canonical> pointing at its own non-www https URL without query strings
Trailing-slash style is consistent site-wide
tasks.note: Titles trimmed to 60 / descriptions to 155 in seo(); all 57 pages pass locally. www already 301s at Cloudflare; http now 301s in the server.

tasks.title: Sitemap lists only live, indexable URLs
tasks.detail: Generate sitemap.xml at build time from the route list, with lastmod. Resubmit in Search Console.
acceptance: sitemap.xml is generated by the build, not hand-edited
It contains no URL that redirects, 404s or is noindex
Each <url> has <lastmod>
tasks.note: Every <url> has <lastmod> (deploy date unless the page has its own). Owner: resubmit sitemap.xml in Search Console after deploy.

tasks.title: Claim and fully build the Google Business Profile
tasks.detail: Category "Juice bar" plus "Beverage distributor", service areas for every Lagos LGA you deliver to, hours, ₦ menu, 20+ real photos, WhatsApp number.

tasks.title: Track orders as conversions in GA4
tasks.detail: Fire events for WhatsApp clicks, phone taps, add-to-cart and checkout so you can see which pages sell. Link GA4 to Search Console.
acceptance: GA4 events: whatsapp_click, phone_click, add_to_cart, begin_checkout, purchase (where applicable)
Events fire once per action (verified in GA4 DebugView instructions in PR)
No PII sent in event params
tasks.note: Events wired (add_to_cart, begin_checkout, purchase, whatsapp_click, phone_click). Owner: paste the GA4 Measurement ID into GA_MEASUREMENT_ID in apps/customer/src/lib/analytics.ts; until then nothing loads.

tasks.title: Keyword subhead on the homepage

acceptance: Homepage has the keyword line in the first viewport on mobile
Only one H1 on the page

tasks.title: Fix broken template links
tasks.detail: Google crawled literal /blog/$slug, /juices/$id, /month and /week URLs: some links render before their route params are filled. Find and fix them.
acceptance: No rendered href contains '$' or an unfilled route param
/month and /week are not linked as standalone pages
Prerendered HTML for every route checked by a script in the PR
tasks.note: No live page renders a $ or /month,/week link (checked all 57 pages); the old URLs 301 via F1.

tasks.title: Fast mobile pages
tasks.detail: Compress bottle images to WebP/AVIF with width/height set; lazy-load below the fold.
acceptance: Lighthouse mobile performance >= 85 on /, /juices and one product page (report in PR)
LCP image is not lazy-loaded and has fetchpriority=high
tasks.note: Images to WebP (35 MB -> 1.5 MB in src/assets), width/height, LCP fetchpriority=high, no fade on hero/product bottle, fonts non-blocking, compressed JS/CSS. Local Lighthouse mobile: /juices 91-96, product 86-93, home 54-68 before the hero fade fix. Re-measure / on PageSpeed Insights after deploy.
